data.desc: Polibeli Group Ltd (NASDAQ: PLBL) is a leading digital supply chain services and distribution-sales provider with business operations in a number of countries around the globe, including Japan, Indonesia, Singapore, Korea, the US, France and Italy. The company offers end-to-end solutions including products procurement, channel distribution, logistics services, brand operations, and digital marketing services to both upstream and downstream business partners. Building on its cross-border commerce and retail digitalization capabilities, Polibeli is expanding into integrated enterprise AI services.
